```{r, results='hide', warning=FALSE}
# install packages if needed
## install.packages(c("tidyverse", "broom", "readxl", "irr", "writexl", "knitr"))
# load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(readxl)
library(irr)
library(writexl)
library(knitr)
```
Read Dataset & Data Cleaning
```{r}
# Read raw data file into data frame
data_raw <- read_xlsx("Final_Sample.xlsx")
```

```{r}
# Delete unecessary lines and replace Yes/No with 1/0
data <- data_raw |>
  select(-(1:17)) |> 
  mutate(across(Q7:Q17, ~ ifelse(. == "Yes", 1, 0))) |> 
  slice(-1) |> 
  rename("Review_ID" = Q4,
         "Category" = Q2,
         "Genre" = Q3,
         "Post Date" = Q6,
         "Played Hours" = Q5,
         "Coder Remark" = Q20)
```

```{r}
# Extract data for intercoder reliability testing
intercoder_df <- data |> 
  filter(grepl("_(10|[1-9])$", `Review_ID`)) |> 
  select(-2,-3,-5,-6,-18)
```

```{r, results='hide'}
# Turn the data format into long
long_data <- intercoder_df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = Q7:Q17,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )

sum(is.na(long_data))
```

ICR with Cronbach's Alpha
```{r}
# Rename columns by variable names
var_names <- c(
  Q7  = "Environment design",
  Q8  = "Character appearance",
  Q9  = "Audio",
  Q10 = "Aesthetic dimension",
  Q11 = "Plot",
  Q12 = "Character buildi",
  Q13 = "Narrative dimension",
  Q14 = "Challenge",
  Q15 = "Control",
  Q16 = "Mechanism",
  Q17 = "Gameplay dimension"
)
```

```{r, results='hide'}
# ICR Results
results <- list()

for (v in unique(long_data$variable)) {

  temp <- long_data |>
    filter(variable == v) |>
    select(Review_ID, Coder, value) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = Coder, values_from = value)

  alpha <- kripp.alpha(t(as.matrix(temp[,-1])), method = "nominal")

  results[[ var_names[[v]] ]] <- alpha$value
}
```


```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Summary of ICR Results Table
alpha_table <- data.frame(
  Question           = names(var_names)[match(names(results), var_names)],
  Variable           = names(results),
  Dimension          = c("Aesthetic", "Aesthetic", "Aesthetic", "Aesthetic",
                         "Narrative", "Narrative", "Narrative",
                         "Gameplay", "Gameplay", "Gameplay", "Gameplay")[
                           match(names(results), var_names)],
  Krippendorff_alpha = round(unlist(results), 3),
  row.names          = NULL
)

# Interpretation label (Krippendorff's suggested cut-offs)
alpha_table$Agreement <- cut(alpha_table$Krippendorff_alpha,
                             breaks = c(-Inf, 0.667, 0.8, Inf),
                             labels = c("Tentative", "Acceptable", "Good"), 
                             right = FALSE)

# Sort by Q number so the order matches
alpha_table <- alpha_table[order(as.numeric(sub("Q", "", alpha_table$Question))), ]

kable(alpha_table, row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Krippendorff's alpha by variable")
```
